answer_text:
Here's a comprehensive breakdown of how long sliced American cheese lasts, depending on the type and storage method:

---

## 🧀 Sliced American Cheese Shelf Life

### **Individually Wrapped Slices (e.g., Kraft Singles) — Unopened**
Processed American cheese tends to last around **1–2 months unopened**. The expiration date printed on packages is generally about **five to six months** after the cheese is produced. Unopened slices can last up to **two months beyond the printed date**, though you should toss the cheese once it starts looking dried-out.

### **Deli-Sliced American Cheese — Refrigerated**
After sliced American deli cheese is purchased from the deli, it may be refrigerated for **2 to 3 weeks** — the sell-by date on the package may expire during that storage period, but the cheese will remain safe to use after the sell-by date if it has been properly stored.

### **After Opening**
Once opened, the shelf life reduces significantly. Generally, opened processed American cheese slices last around **2 to 4 weeks** in the fridge if kept properly sealed and stored at consistent temperatures.

Some manufacturers recommend even shorter windows — Land O'Lakes recommends using pre-sliced cheeses **within 5–7 days** once the package is opened, and if you purchase freshly sliced deli cheese, using it within **5–7 days of purchase** for best quality.

---

## ❄️ Freezing
To further extend the shelf life of sliced American cheese, you can freeze it — just place the cheese in the freezer before the number of days shown for refrigerator storage has elapsed. Well-wrapped and stored American cheese will be good in the freezer for **up to 10 months**. Sliced American cheese that has been defrosted can be kept for an additional **3 to 4 days** in the refrigerator before using. Note that frozen cheese may become crumbly and lose some of its flavor, making thawed slices best suited for cooked dishes like sauces, soups, and casseroles.

---

## ⚠️ At Room Temperature
At room temperature, even processed cheese can only hold up for about **two hours**.

---

## 🔍 Signs It's Gone Bad
Monitor for signs of spoilage such as **discoloration, bad odor, slimy texture, or mold**. The Mayo Clinic warns that mold can easily penetrate through soft and pre-sliced cheeses — so if you find that one American cheese slice has spoiled, you should throw the rest out.

---

### Quick Reference Summary:

| Type | Unopened | Opened/After Purchase |
|---|---|---|
| Individually wrapped (Kraft-style) | Up to 6 months | 2–4 weeks |
| Deli-sliced | 2–3 weeks | 5–7 days |
| Frozen | Up to 10 months | 3–4 days after thawing |
